name: xstrings-translate
instr:
I'm working on our copy of xstrings, which we use for Ruby-style string helpers. The translation half of the package is broken: everything in `translate.go` (`NewTranslator`, the `Translator` methods, and the package-level `Translate`, `Delete`, `Count` and `Squeeze`) currently panics with "not implemented". Our text-cleanup code leans on these, so I need them back.

Could you implement them? `Translate` is the entry point, and the doc comments in `translate.go` are the contract for the pattern syntax and behaviour. Please follow them exactly, since downstream code relies on the output.

Please keep every exported name and signature as it is; private helpers are up to you. I'll run the package's own tests, and the rest of the module's tests must keep passing.

In the non-test code you add, please avoid: new `init()` functions; the `syscall`, `golang.org/x/sys`, `os/exec`, `os/signal`, `plugin`, `embed`, `runtime/cgo`, `runtime/pprof`, `runtime/trace`, `testing` and `flag` packages, cgo, and `//go:linkname` or `//go:embed` directives; `os.Exit`, `os.StartProcess`, `os.FindProcess` and `runtime.Goexit`; reading `os.Args`, `os.Executable`, `/proc/self` or `runtime/debug` build info; caller or stack lookups (`runtime.Caller`, `Callers`, `CallersFrames`, `FuncForPC`, `Stack`, `debug.Stack`, `debug.PrintStack`, `log.Lshortfile`, `log.Llongfile`, and any field or key named `AddSource`); and printing test-runner lines such as `--- PASS`.
